title: (RHEA-2014:1175) Release of Satellite 6.0
portal_summary: Red Hat Satellite 6.0 is now available.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Satellite|Red Hat Satellite Capsule|6.0|x86_64
Red Hat Satellite|Red Hat Satellite Capsule|6.0|x86_64
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a system management solution that allows organizations to
configure and maintain their systems without necessity to provide public
Internet access to their servers or other client systems. It also performs
provisioning and configuration management of predefined standard operating
environments.

Red Hat Satellite 6 integrates several other projects that provide particular
functionalities in Provisioning and Configuration Management, and Content and
Subscription Management. The following projects are the most fundamental:
Katello, Foreman, Candlepin, Pulp, and Puppet. 

Katello is a subscription and repository management application that enables
users to subscribe to Red Hat repositories and download the content. Foreman is
an open source application responsible for provisioning, configuration and life
cycle management of the systems. Candlepin is a software collection used by
Katello to handle subscription management. Pulp is a service used by Katello to
handle repository and content management. And Puppet is an automation software
used to handle provisioning and configuration tasks.
  
This update introduces Red Hat Satellite 6.0. In this release, Satellite focuses
on improving in all main areas of its scope, namely:

* Content Management: Satellite allows users to mirror the content and
configuration of their systems. It also enables them to determine how the
downloaded content should be distributed to particular machines.

* Configuration Management: Satellite can be used to define configuration
policies for machines and ensure compliance to those policies.

* Provisioning: Satellite allows users to use system definitions to build
various configurations on bare metal, virt fabrics, and in the cloud
environment.

* Subscription Management: With Satellite, users can track their subscriptions
from the order to the endpoint machine.

For the full list of new features see the Release notes on the following site:

https://access.redhat.com/site/documentation/

Note: Red Hat Satellite 6.0 is available for installation on Red Hat Enterprise
Linux Server 6 and Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server 7. For full details,
including supported architecture combinations, refer to the Red Hat Satellite 6
Installation Guide on the following site:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_Satellite/

All users of Red Hat Satellite are advised to install this newly released
version.
